plan_review.notes: Approved with six adopted changes: explicit two-click action matrix, persistent expert actions, centralized rerender state, accessibility semantics, dirty-state safety, and deterministic interaction coverage.

Favorite bleed found during live use was fixed with stale-form bypass on server-loaded renders and browser regression coverage.
